sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt: Use of Proceeds We estimate that the net proceeds from the sale of the Notes, after deducting the underwriters’ discounts and estimated offering expenses, will be approximately $ . We intend to use the net proceeds from the sale of the Notes to refinance certain existing indebtedness, including to repay at maturity our 2027 Notes, with any remaining net proceeds to be used for general corporate and working capital purposes, which may include repayment of borrowings under our commercial paper program. Pending such use, we may use some or all of the net proceeds for general corporate and working capital purposes. We have broad discretion in the use of such proceeds.
